# DSH Studio v0.7.1

这是一个面向安装可靠性和故障自救的修复版本。它修复了 Issue #2 报告的 Harness 安装
永久停在「安装中」，并新增无需启动桌面窗口即可导出诊断包的命令。

## 新增

- 新增 `--export-diagnostics` 无界面命令。它会在 Tauri、窗口和 Harness 启动前读取
  已有日志与崩溃证据，生成限额诊断 ZIP，并把压缩包的绝对路径输出到终端。
- 诊断包继续复用现有脱敏、证据数量和 50 MiB 总量限制；默认写入下载目录，目录不可用
  时安全回退到应用数据目录，每次使用唯一时间戳文件名。

## 变更与安全

- 托管 Harness 安装固定使用合格依赖锁记录的 `https://registry.npmjs.org/`。npm 不再能把
  已锁定的官方 tarball 自动改写到用户配置的不完整镜像，代理配置仍可正常生效。
- npm 的 `node-pty`、`koffi` 等原生生命周期阶段会实时写入 Studio 日志，不再在数百个包
  下载结束后突然没有任何可见进展。
- 下载失败最多重试两次，单次获取限制为 60 秒；连续 120 秒没有输出或总安装时间超过
  20 分钟时，Studio 会停止受监管的 npm 进程，并保留原子安装恢复语义。
- 本次没有扩大桌面桥接面；插件公共合同继续使用 Protocol 3。

## 修复与打磨

- 修复 [Issue #2](https://github.com/Moresyl/dsh-studio/issues/2)：Harness 安装不会再在
  包解析或原生依赖阶段永久显示「安装中」，失败会返回可操作的网络/离线版建议。
- 修复 Windows 上 npm 已退出、但生命周期脚本的后代进程仍持有输出管道时，Studio
  一直等待日志结束的问题；输出只会短暂排空，不会阻塞安装收尾。
- 修复 Studio 自身无法启动时只能依赖窗口内「关于」页导出诊断的死角；新命令的参数
  不合法时会立即以非零状态退出，不会意外启动桌面应用。

## 安装与更新

可从下方 Assets 选择 Windows、macOS 或 Linux 的 Lite/Full 安装包；Windows 另有便携版，
macOS 另有 Universal Lite。网络受限且无法稳定访问官方 npm registry 时，建议直接使用
Full / Offline；Lite 与 Full 使用同一应用身份和数据目录，可覆盖升级。

请使用 `SHA256SUMS.txt` 核对下载；应用内更新还会验证 Tauri 更新签名。当前仓库仍未配置
Windows Authenticode 与 Apple Developer ID 凭据，因此操作系统可能继续显示未知发布者或
要求首次放行；这与已强制执行的更新签名和 SHA-256 校验是不同层次的验证。

[英文更新日志](https://github.com/Moresyl/dsh-studio/blob/v0.7.1/CHANGELOG.md) · [中文更新日志](https://github.com/Moresyl/dsh-studio/blob/v0.7.1/CHANGELOG.zh-CN.md) · [比较 v0.7.0...v0.7.1](https://github.com/Moresyl/dsh-studio/compare/v0.7.0...v0.7.1)

<!-- dsh-notes:en -->
# DSH Studio v0.7.1

This patch release focuses on installation reliability and recovery. It fixes
the Harness install remaining on “Installing” indefinitely as reported in Issue
#2, and adds diagnostics that work without launching the desktop window.

## Added

- `--export-diagnostics` collects existing bounded, redacted logs and crash
  evidence before Tauri, a window or Harness starts, writes a uniquely named ZIP,
  and prints its absolute path.
- The command uses Downloads when it is a safe real directory and falls back to
  application data. The existing evidence-count and 50 MiB archive limits still
  apply.

## Changed and secured

- Managed Harness installation is pinned to the official registry recorded by
  the qualified dependency lock. npm can no longer rewrite locked official
  tarballs through an incomplete user mirror; configured proxies still work.
- Native `node-pty`, `koffi` and other lifecycle stages are streamed to Studio's
  log. Fetches retry at most twice and each fetch is bounded to 60 seconds.
- Studio stops the supervised npm process after 120 seconds without output or a
  20-minute total install, while preserving transactional recovery.
- The desktop bridge surface is unchanged and remains on Protocol 3.

## Fixed and polished

- Fixed [Issue #2](https://github.com/Moresyl/dsh-studio/issues/2): package
  resolution or native installation can no longer leave Harness installation
  spinning forever; failures now include an actionable retry/offline message.
- On Windows, inherited output handles from lifecycle descendants no longer keep
  Studio waiting after npm itself has exited.
- A broken desktop startup no longer blocks diagnostic collection. Invalid
  headless arguments exit non-zero instead of accidentally launching Studio.

## Install and update

Choose a Lite or Full installer for Windows, macOS or Linux from Assets. Windows
also provides a portable build and macOS provides Universal Lite. Use Full /
Offline when the official npm registry is not reliably reachable. Both editions
share application identity and data directories and can upgrade one another.

Check downloads with `SHA256SUMS.txt`; in-app updates also verify the required
Tauri signature. Windows Authenticode and Apple Developer ID credentials are
still not configured, so OS trust warnings may remain separate from updater and
SHA-256 verification.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/Moresyl/dsh-studio/blob/v0.7.1/CHANGELOG.md) · [中文更新日志](https://github.com/Moresyl/dsh-studio/blob/v0.7.1/CHANGELOG.zh-CN.md) · [Compare v0.7.0...v0.7.1](https://github.com/Moresyl/dsh-studio/compare/v0.7.0...v0.7.1)

<!-- dsh-notes:end -->
